4 أَنَبْتُهُ عَنْهُ . (K,) and ↓ اسْتَنَبْتُهُ , (TA.) I made him to supply his [another's] place to act in him place or stead, or as his substitute, lieutenant, deputy, factor, or agent; (K, Msb;) فِى كَذَا in such an affair. (Msb.) ―
-b2- See 1. ―
-b3- أَتَانِى فُلَانٌ فَمَا أَنَبْتُ لَهُ Such a one came to me, and I cared not for him, or paid any regard to him. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
